sentences.text:
Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
12.06.2024 jb.
jdt. C.R.R. 2187 of 2024
 In Re : Amit Bhattacharjee
 ... Petitioner.

Mr. Anirban Dutta
 Mr. Ayan Mondal

The petitioner seeks quashing of proceeding being G.R. case no. 4384 of 2022 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, at Barasat primarily on the ground that the private opposite party is admittedly a transgender and there is no ingredient of offence in the complaint under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Upon consideration of the submission made by the petitioner, this Court is of the view that the matter needs to be considered on merits.

The petitioner is directed to serve copy of the revisional application along with annexure thereto upon the State through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the opposite party no. 2 by speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
The proceeding being G.R. case no. 4384 of 2022 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, at Barasat is stayed till 31st August, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
Let the matter appear under the heading 'Contested Application' on 9th August, 2024.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
